```{python}
#| label: fig-process-backend
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "CMOS process, steps 9 to 11—back-end: (a) inter-layer dielectric deposition, CMP, and contact formation, (b) first metal layer sputtered and patterned, and (c) inter-metal dielectric, vias, and second metal layer; the finished wafer is then passivated and opened at the pads."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pyutil import process as pr


def feol(ax):
    pr.wafer(ax, pwell=True, nwell=True, trenches=pr.STI_X)
    pr.sti(ax, fox=pr.FOX_H)
    pr.gate_stack(ax)
    pr.implants(ax)
    pr.spacers(ax)
    pr.silicide(ax)


fig, axs = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(6.5, 7.0))

ax = axs[0]
feol(ax)
pr.dielectric(ax)
pr.contacts(ax)
pr.setup(ax, '(a) inter-layer dielectric, CMP, and contacts', ymax=6.0)

ax = axs[1]
feol(ax)
pr.dielectric(ax)
pr.metal1(ax)
pr.setup(ax, '(b) metal-1 sputtered (Al) and patterned', ymax=6.4)

ax = axs[2]
feol(ax)
pr.dielectric(ax, top=pr.M2_Y)
pr.metal1(ax)
pr.via_metal2(ax)
pr.setup(ax, '(c) inter-metal dielectric, via-12, and metal-2', ymax=7.4)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
